cases.prompt: Audit why `https://shop.example.org` shows "Deceptive site ahead" since Monday. I own the domain and have Search Console access; fixes and resubmission need a separate go-ahead. Evidence: Search Console Security issues lists "Social engineering content" with samples under `/promo/`. `/promo/index.html` loads `https://cdn-stat.xyz/a.js`, which is an `eval(atob(...))` blob that injects a fake login form. `git log` shows that tag was added in commit 3fa2c1 by the deploy key `ci-legacy`, not by a developer. The deployed build reports revision `a91b07e`, which contains 3fa2c1. TLS is valid; HTTP redirects to HTTPS; robots.txt allows `/promo/`.
sourceAnchors: Separate confirmed defects from weak signals.
Produce a remediation, deployment, re-scan, and official-submission plan for verified causes.

requiredEvidence: obfuscated third-party script injecting a login form
review request only after verified remediation
forbiddenClaims: the warning will be removed within 72 hours
